tools.name: lookup_country_calling_code
tools.description: Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region.

q.description: Free-text search, such as United Kingdom, London, or AUS.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as GB or GBR.

dialCode.description: Calling code with or without plus sign, such as +44 or 44.

limit.description: Maximum number of countries to return.
